content:
ani: quick report: our onboarding worker keeps crashing with JSONDecodeError from the Python SDK when an upstream returns a 422 with plain text. no typed exception to catch so the background task dies.
max-k: that's been biting multiple teams. do you have a minimal repro/headers?
ani: headers: Content-Type: text/plain; status 422; body: "validation failed: missing email". call site is inside asyncio.create_task -> await client.create_profile(...).
hannah: two things we should do: (1) normalize non-2xx into a typed exception (RedwoodAPIError) with attributes (status_code, message/detail, raw_body, request_id, is_retryable) and (2) ensure retry middleware consults is_retryable instead of retrying on any exception.
jules: agreed. propose small API: ```python
class RedwoodAPIError(Exception):
    status_code: int
    message: str
    raw_body: Optional[str]
    request_id: Optional[str]
    def is_retryable(self) -> bool: ...
```
hannah: parsing fallback in http client: try json, except JSONDecodeError: try xml, except Exception: raw = await resp.text(); parsed = None. If resp.status is 2xx return parsed or raw, else build RedwoodAPIError using parsed.get('detail') if available else raw, set __cause__ to parse exception.
max-k: important: retryer must do `retryable = getattr(exc, 'is_retryable', None); if retryable is not None: use that; else: fallback to network/5xx` — prevents JSONDecodeError from causing retries on 4xx.
ani: add tests: text/plain 422 -> RedwoodAPIError with raw_body and is_retryable False; json problem document 422 -> parsed detail; 503 -> is_retryable True and retried; sync client parity for requests (ValueError path).
jules: small typing ask: include stub exports so `except RedwoodAPIError as e` gives mypy-friendly attributes. also add example in quickstart showing recommended catch pattern.
ci-bot: Created issue #2710: "py sdk: typed http errors + parsing fallback + stricter retry defaults" (PR draft linked)
ani: thanks — this will stop noisy retries and make onboarding less confusing. :thumbsup:
